worldcombat.skill.triplekick.summary: Plant your feet and drive three straight kicks along the direction locked at release: each rolls its own accuracy and takes the real first contact, rising in power with every hit, and a whiff ends the string. The first two kicks only tap the target to keep it in line; the last one delivers the whole string's shove at once. Drive form kicks heavier and pushes further but needs to be closer and chains slower.
worldcombat.skill.triplekick.description: The first kick deals about %1$s fighting contact damage, for %2$s kicks in a row; each landed kick adds %3$s times the first kick's power to the next one.

Each kick reaches %1$s blocks along the aim with a %2$s-block contact radius and settles on the first enemy it really touches, never hitting the same target twice in one kick; each kick hits for %3$s and the kicks are %4$s s apart.
The three kicks together shove the target %1$s blocks along the kick direction; the first two each push only a quarter and keep it in line, while the last kick adds the remaining shove at once.
worldcombat.skill.triplekick.drive.on: Drive form: every kick hits for 1.12x and pushes 1.5x, at 0.85x kicking reach, -2% hit chance, +1 tick between kicks, +1 tick recovery and +2 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.triplekick.drive.off: Quick form (native): 1.03x kicking reach, -1 tick between kicks, +2% hit chance and a 4-tick shorter cooldown, at a lighter hit and shorter push per kick.
worldcombat.skill.triplekick.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.triplekick.growth.0: From level %1$s the first kick rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.triplekick.growth.1: From level %1$s the first kick rises to %2$s and the kicking reach extends to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.triplekick.use.0: Three straight kicks down a narrow lane
worldcombat.skill.triplekick.use.1: Each landed kick makes the next one heavier
worldcombat.skill.triplekick.use.2: Ground-hugging and quick to come back
On (drive): each kick hits for 1.12x and pushes 1.5x, at 0.85x kicking reach, -2% hit chance, +1 tick between kicks, +1 tick recovery and +2 ticks cooldown. Off (quick, the native form): kicks reach further (1.03x), chain tighter (-1 tick), hit for +2% and cool down faster, at a lighter hit per kick.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of kicking. This is a close-range straight kick, so a large value often still cannot reach.
worldcombat.skill.triplekick.description: Every kick rolls its own hit: a whiff, a wall as the first contact, no other enemy ahead, or a refused hit stops the flurry at the real position. The direction is locked at release, so a target that steps out of the line dodges the later kicks.
